According to the onboarding documentation, **Hermes automatically passes `stream_options: {"include_usage": true}`** to OpenAI-compatible endpoints so that `/usage` token metrics work properly. You do not need to manually inject it via `extra_body`.

If usage metrics are still failing to record, ensure your provider configuration is explicitly set as a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint rather than relying on auto-detection:

```yaml
model:
  default: <your-model-name>
  provider: custom
  base_url: https://localai.example.internal/v1
fallback_providers: []
```

*(Note: Ensure `provider: custom` is set explicitly, as `provider: auto` can lead to provider conflicts or unexpected handling of endpoint capabilities).*
